body:
Interestingly this doesn't seem to be the case anymore with the latest build of `master` (which uses typescript 5.5.2). Therefore the next release (scheduled for tomorrow) won't have the automatic insertion of `///reference` and it should work all fine.

You can double check this by running this deploy preview: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6246#issuecomment-2182248652

I haven't seen any other reports about this in the past, but I do know that at some point the identifier changed from types/google.maps to types/googlemaps (or the other way round, not sure anymore now)
